song: Don't Think Twice, It's All Right
intro: A farewell song from 1962, built on a tune he picked up from his friend Paul Clayton. It has stayed in the set, in one form or another, through almost every era.

lives.title: Borrowed bones
lives.note: The melody and some phrasing come from "Who's Gonna Buy You Ribbons When I'm Gone", which Paul Clayton had adapted from an older song.

lives.title: Freewheelin'
lives.note: Fast finger-picked guitar and harmonica. On The Freewheelin' Bob Dylan.

lives.title: Peter, Paul and Mary
lives.note: A top ten hit in the US in 1963, following their Blowin' in the Wind.

lives.title: Reggae
lives.note: Turned into a reggae song for the 1978 tour. On Bob Dylan at Budokan.
